[SWS_SM_00206] prepare update
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00004
⌈
State Management
shall provide the service interface
UpdateRequest
to
Update
and Configuration Management
with the method call
PrepareUpdate
thus it
can request
State Management
to perform a preparation of the given
Function
Groups
to be updated.
⌋
